extraction.Name: Lucinda Bettelyoun
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want a patent in fee to her land but accepted it for the reason that she was told that if she did not take it, the land would be sold to pay the taxes
extraction.Recorded patent: does not remember of having the patent recorded
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Mr. Cherry of Martin, S.D. / Merriman, Nebr. for $1000.00; sold to Vic. Allen of Merriman, Nebr. for $2500.00 and got an additional $1500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay taxes and knew she would lose it if she did not sell; could not pay the mortgage so she sold it
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health but has absolutely nothing; has five children; has received no aid from the State, County or Government; land was not sold for debts or taxes; does not think she received all the land was worth but states she was not defrauded and made a fair and square deal; transaction done in 1919; document references 2204/2444; sworn July 5, 1929, Shannon County, South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
